Hero.description: {siteName} is a network of Minecraft servers, combining the survival server <duckburg>DuckBurg</duckburg> and the creative server <duckhood>DuckHood</duckhood>. Everyone will find their path here.

About.label: About
About.title: What is DuckTale?
About.description: DuckTale is more than just Minecraft. It's a community of people who love building, exploring and creating. We've been running since {year} and have grown a warm, close-knit community.

protection.title: Protection & stability
protection.desc: Dedicated servers with DDoS protection, daily backups, 99.9% uptime.

community.title: Living community
community.desc: A friendly Discord, regular events, active admins always around.

duckburg.description: Classic survival with a unique economy, clans, an auction house and hundreds of hours of content.

duckhood.description: A boundless space for your ideas. Personal plots, a shared world, building contests.

Infrastructure.label: Infrastructure
Infrastructure.title: Network architecture
Infrastructure.description: A map of how DuckTale's servers connect. Hover a node or line to see details. Nodes can be dragged, the canvas can be panned.

client.label: Player
client.tooltip: The client connects with Minecraft Java Edition ≥ 1.21.x

proxy.label: Velocity
proxy.tooltip: The Velocity proxy is the entry point to the DuckTale network. Routes traffic between all servers.

auth.label: Auth
auth.tooltip: Authorizes players before letting them onto the servers.

hub.label: Hub
hub.tooltip: The lobby server used to pick a game server.

backup.label: Backups
backup.tooltip: Daily backups of all game data.

edges.clientToProxy: Player connects to the network's entry point
edges.proxyToAuth: Velocity forwards to the authorization service
edges.authToHub: Redirects to the HUB after successful authorization
edges.voiceToDuckburg: Provides voice chat for the DuckBurg server
edges.voiceToDuckhood: Provides voice chat for the DuckHood server
edges.voiceToHub: Provides voice chat for the HUB server
